quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #10
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: What does a solid white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. You can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. You cannot pass.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A solid white line means you cannot pass.

questions.question: How much space should you keep between your car and a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Keep at least three seconds of space between your car and a motorcycle. Even a small bump can cause a rider to fall or get hurt.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT happen when you drink alcohol?

options.text: Your judgment of speed and distance gets worse.
You relax and can focus better.

questions.correctAnswerText: You relax and can focus better.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time, hurts your eyesight, changes how you judge speed and distance, and makes you more likely to take risks. It does not help you focus.

questions.question: At what blood alcohol level can a driver under 21 be charged with underage drunk driving?
questions.explanation: Drivers under 21 can be charged with underage drunk driving at 0.02 percent blood alcohol or higher. This can result in a license suspension for 60 days to two years.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork.
Slow down. The road ahead makes a sharp turn.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down. The road ahead makes a sharp turn.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead makes a sharp turn. Slow down before you reach the curve, just like you would at an intersection turn.

questions.question: What affects your ability to stop?
questions.explanation: Road condition greatly affects how well you can stop. Slow down on slippery or poor roads to keep control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Get ready to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching

questions.explanation: This sign shows a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles often cross or ride near traffic here.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a hill or incline with a curb, which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Turn your front wheels sharply toward the curb.
Turn your front wheels slightly to the right.
Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb. This keeps your car from rolling into traffic. If there is no curb, turn the wheels sharply toward the edge of the road.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: Is never used as a traffic signal.
Has the same meaning as a circular red traffic light.
Means that drivers may turn in the direction indicated by the arrow.
Means that the traffic the arrow is pointing toward must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Has the same meaning as a circular red traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same thing as a red traffic light. Traffic in that lane must stop. You cannot turn in the direction the arrow is pointing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that shows rules drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and find another way.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalk, where should a pedestrian walk?

options.text: Side of the road which has the lightest traffic.
Same side of the road on which traffic is moving.
Side of the road facing oncoming traffic.
Side of the road which has the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Side of the road facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Walk on the side of the road that faces traffic coming toward you. This helps you see oncoming cars.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows a rule that drivers must follow. You cannot park where this sign is displayed.

questions.question: What is a speed limit?

options.text: The maximum or minimum legal speed you can travel on a road under dangerous conditions.
The maximum or minimum legal speed you can travel on a road under ideal conditions.
The suggested speed to travel on a road under ideal conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum or minimum legal speed you can travel on a road under ideal conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit is the maximum or minimum legal speed for that road under good conditions. You can drive slower, but never faster. Always drive slower in school zones, work zones, or bad weather.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a sharp right turn coming up on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: Signs for public recreation areas are:
questions.explanation: Brown signs show cultural sites, historical areas, and public recreation areas. They help you find places of interest when driving in new locations.

questions.question: What is your biggest concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
Your car could hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto a low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control. Keep both hands on the wheel and steer gently back onto the road.

questions.question: What does a stop sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop and go when it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on the intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires you to come to a complete stop. Let other vehicles and pedestrians pass. Continue when it is safe.

questions.question: Traffic signals use arrows to control turns from specific lanes. A solid yellow arrow means:

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It has the same meaning as a yellow circular traffic light.
You may turn in the direction of the arrow.
A green arrow will appear next.

questions.correctAnswerText: It has the same meaning as a yellow circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same thing as a yellow light. Slow down and get ready for a red light.

questions.question: When can you pass on the right shoulder?

options.text: When the car in front of you is turning.
When the car in front of you is driving too slowly.

questions.explanation: You cannot drive on the shoulder or off the pavement to pass another car. Passing on the right is not allowed.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic light colors from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are always arranged the same way. Red is on top, yellow in the middle, and green on the bottom. When arranged horizontally, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: A single broken yellow line in the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is allowed when safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken line means you can pass the car ahead when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What should you do if your right wheels leave the road?

options.text: Pull completely off the road and get back on when safe.
Speed up and steer back onto the road quickly.
Release the accelerator, slow down, and ease back onto the road when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Release the accelerator, slow down, and ease back onto the road when safe.
questions.explanation: Stay calm if your wheels leave the road. Release the accelerator and steer parallel to the road. Slow down and gently steer back with a small turn of the wheel. Check for traffic first. Keep both hands on the wheel.

questions.question: When turning left onto a one-way street, you should finish the turn in:

options.text: The lane closest to your previous lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to your previous lane.
questions.explanation: Always turn into the lane that is closest to where you came from. This means turning into the lane nearest to your previous lane.

questions.question: What is distracted driving?

options.text: Just as safe as normal driving.

questions.explanation: Distracted driving is extremely dangerous. It puts you, your passengers, pedestrians, cyclists, and other drivers at risk. Paying full attention to the road helps prevent crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: Two solid white lines mark a crosswalk. As a driver, you should know:

options.text: Cars have the right-of-way over pedestrians.
Pedestrians in a crosswalk have the right-of-way.
No one has the right-of-way in a crosswalk.
Pedestrians must get out of the way of traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians in a crosswalk have the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Crosswalk lines show pedestrians where to safely cross. Lines may be horizontal, vertical, or both. You must always stop for pedestrians in a crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must bear either right or left.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign do?

options.text: Alerts drivers to food and gas locations.

questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or dangers ahead. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting. The road splits into two one-way roads with a median between them. You must stay to the right.

questions.question: What is a safe way to drive through a curve?

options.text: Slow down entering, speed up exiting.
Keep the same speed through the curve.
Speed up entering, slow down exiting.
Stay near the right edge of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down entering, speed up exiting.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you enter a curve and gradually speed up as you exit. Speeding up when entering a curve makes it harder to control your car.

questions.question: If another car is about to hit you, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians who may not see you. If you think another driver is about to hit you, sound your horn immediately.
